purpose: 3-fold family cross-validation run, per fold. The flagged values are the ONLY recipe; the trainer refuses to start if any flagged flag differs from the file. Fold variable (--validation-family) is declared in 'folds' and intentionally not flagged.
decisionRule: v2: decide on report.threeFoldCv — per fold matched >= production matched + 0.20; mean(matched) >= 0.75; min(matched) >= 0.70; per fold matched >= previous candidate matched - 0.03; draft aggregate >= 0.85 and every fold >= production draft. Absolute 90% lines are reported-only. One-shot blind family judged by the v2 criteria against the same-family production baseline (matched >= 0.75 and >= production + 0.20; draft >= max(0.85, production draft)).
expectedSelectionGapNote: Measured once: dev 0.9189 -> blind family unit 0.8333 (gap 8.6pp) and matched bucket is the load-bearing reading. Any new independent family is expected to land 3-8pp below the fold mean; a family will only be authorized when fold mean minus that gap stays >= 0.90.
whyOneVariable: This run changes exactly one modelling variable versus 4764fd2: symbolic features gain the 256-bucket text-hash block (19 -> 275 dims). mlp hidden widens 32 -> 96 because the input block grew; everything else is frozen from 4764fd2.
frozenJudgeNote: Negative-mining judge is pinned to the 4764fd2 candidate so the mined pair set cannot drift across folds when each fold pushes its own candidate.
decisionRuleChangeNote: v2 approved after the three-fold run: matched spread across families measured 22.9pp and the hardest family's linear text ceiling measured 0.79, so a per-family absolute 90% line cannot discriminate. Flags (the recipe) are unchanged.
